sn17.23:1.3: saddhā bhikkhave, upāsikā ekaṃ puttaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya
sn17.23:1.4: “tādiso tāta bhavāhi, yādiso citto ca gahapati hatthako ca āḷavako.
sn17.23:1.5: esā bhikkhave tulā, etaṃ pamāṇaṃ, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ yadidaṃ citto ca gahapati, hatthako ca āḷavako.
sn17.23:1.6: “sace kho tvaṃ tāta, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajasi,
sn17.23:1.8: esā bhikkhave tulā, etaṃ pamāṇaṃ, sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yadidaṃ sāriputtamoggalānā .
sn17.23:1.9: “mā ca kho tvaṃ tāta sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātū”ti.
sn17.23:1.10: tañce bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇāti, so tassa hoti antarāyāya.
sn17.23:1.12: [uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma …pe…] evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave, sikkhitabbanti.
